description: This file contains permission check logic for team members within a proxy management system, including permission retrieval, validation, and access control for key management endpoints.

classes.name: TeamMemberPermissionChecks
classes.description: A class providing static methods for managing and checking team member permissions within the system.

methods.name: get_permissions_for_team_member
methods.description: Retrieves the list of permissions assigned to a specific team member, defaulting if none are set.

methods.name: _get_list_of_route_enum_as_str
methods.description: Converts a list of route enums to a list of their string values.

methods.name: can_team_member_execute_key_management_endpoint
methods.description: Checks if a team member has permission to execute a specific key management endpoint.

methods.name: does_team_member_have_permissions_for_endpoint
methods.description: Determines if a team member has permission to access a specific endpoint, raising an exception if not.

methods.name: user_belongs_to_keys_team
methods.description: Verifies if a user belongs to the team associated with a specific key.

methods.name: get_all_available_team_member_permissions
methods.description: Returns a list of all possible team member permissions.

methods.name: default_team_member_permissions
methods.description: Returns the default set of team member permissions.
